title: Death Machine
lyrics:
[00:10.10] This is no exaggeration, we're living in a death machine
[00:14.50] And no, it's not just your imagination
[00:16.53] You've been living in a death machine
[00:20.16] Some of us are passengers, and some of us are driving
[00:24.56] Almost everybody's getting bled to death to keep the motor running
[00:30.09] I'm not being hyperbolic, this place is a death machine
[00:35.22] Literally and symbolic in the belly of the death machine
[00:40.69] Doesn't matter who is steering, it's just gonna keep on killing
[00:45.29] 'Til we find a way to finally break the routine
[00:48.87] You might as well face the music
[00:51.04] You're living in a death machine
[00:53.44] 
[01:02.33] This ain't no call to action, can't get no satisfaction
[01:07.24] Not even sure what I was trying to sing
[01:10.98] But at least until it stops existing
[01:13.86] This fucking time bomb keeps ticking
[01:16.29] Shit man, goddamn, that's just obscene
[01:21.98] Living in a death machine
[01:26.93] In the belly of the death machine
[01:32.16] Everybody do the death machine
[01:37.40] Living in a death machine
[01:39.57]
